gamesync.config.title: GameSync
gamesync.config.option.target_worlds.des: World names to sync. Must match the save folder name exactly. Add an entry for each world you want synced.
gamesync.config.option.cloud_provider.de: Target cloud provider for sync operations. Choose S3 for any S3-compatible storage, such as Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2 or MinIO, and fill in the S3 / R2 tab.
Triggers an additional sync at given intervals, independent of manual or world-unload syncs.
gamesync.config.group.connection.desc: Create an OAuth 'Desktop app' credential in the Google Cloud Console, then enter its details below.
Destination Google Drive folder ID, taken from the folder's URL: drive.google.com/drive/folders/<FOLDER_ID>
gamesync.config.option.client_id.desc: OAuth 2.0 Client ID from a Google Cloud 'Desktop app' credential (APIs & Services > Credentials).
gamesync.config.option.client_secret.des: OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with the Client ID above. Per Google's own documentation, desktop-app secrets are not confidential by design, but this file should still not be shared publicly.
gamesync.config.group.s3_connection.desc: Create an API token with read and write access to your bucket (Cloudflare R2: R2 > Manage API tokens), then enter its details below.
gamesync.config.option.s3_endpoint.desc: S3 API endpoint. Cloudflare R2: https://<ACCOUNT_ID>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. AWS: https://s3.<REGION>.amazonaws.com
gamesync.config.option.s3_region.desc: Region used for request signing. Cloudflare R2 uses 'auto'; for AWS use the bucket's region, e.g. eu-central-1.
gamesync.config.option.s3_bucket.desc: Name of the bucket worlds are stored in.
gamesync.config.option.s3_prefix.desc: Folder inside the bucket. Each synced world is stored under <prefix>/<world name>/. Leave empty to use the bucket root.
Access key ID of the API token.
gamesync.config.option.s3_secret_access_: Secret access key of the API token. This is confidential: anyone who has it can read and overwrite your bucket. Never share your config file.
gamesync.world.toggle.on.tooltip:
Cloud sync: ON
This world syncs when you open and close it. Click to stop syncing it (the cloud copy is kept).
gamesync.world.toggle.off.tooltip:
Cloud sync: OFF
Click to sync this world to the cloud. It uploads right away, then again whenever you open and close it.
File count threshold above which sync execution switches from sequential to multithreaded.
gamesync.config.option.max_workers.desc: Maximum number of concurrent file transfers in multithreaded mode.
gamesync.config.option.max_retries.desc: Maximum retry attempts per file before the transfer is marked as failed.
gamesync.config.option.retry_delay.desc: Delay between retry attempts, in milliseconds.
gamesync.config.option.debug_mode.desc: Enables verbose debug logging for diagnostics.
